---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new check, output format, or capability
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem does this solve

The security gap, reporting need, or workflow this would address.

## Proposed check or feature

If you're proposing a new check, describe what it would detect and roughly what
it would query (read-only SOQL / Tooling / REST only).

## Risk framing

Why does this matter from a security standpoint? What's the realistic impact of
the misconfiguration it would catch?

## Compliance / framework relevance (optional)

Any OWASP / SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / SBS / NZ framework controls this maps to.

## Additional context

Links, examples, or related issues.
